title: The glued twisting sheaf O(1) of P^n_Z is the sheaf attached to S(1)
statement: Let $n$ be a finite nonempty index set, $S=\mathbf Z[T_k:k\in n]$ graded by total degree, $P=\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj] with standard opens $U_i=D_+(T_i)$, $\Gamma(U_i,\mathcal O_P)=S_{(T_i)}$. Let $\mathcal O_P(1)$ be the invertible module of [def-pc-projective-space-twist] (with $A=\mathbf Z$, $d=1$): glued from the free modules $\mathcal O_{U_i}e_i$ with $e_i=(T_i/T_j)\,e_j$ on $U_i\cap U_j$; for $k\in n$ let $T^{\mathrm{gl}}_k\in\Gamma(P,\mathcal O_P(1))$ be the global section with $T^{\mathrm{gl}}_k|_{U_i}=(T_k/T_i)\,e_i$ for every $i$ (these agree on overlaps by the transition rule). Let $\widetilde{S(1)}$ be the quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_P$-module attached to the shifted graded $S$-module $S(1)$, so $\widetilde{S(1)}(D_+(f))=(S_f)_1$ for homogeneous $f$ of positive degree, with the global sections $T_k$ given by $T_k/1\in(S_f)_1$ on every $D_+(f)$. Then there is exactly one isomorphism of $\mathcal O_P$-modules $\theta:\mathcal O_P(1)\to\widetilde{S(1)}$ with $\theta(e_i)=T_i/1\in(S_{T_i})_1$ for every $i$, and $\theta(T^{\mathrm{gl}}_k)=T_k$ for every $k$.

proof.text: By the existing definition ProjectiveSpace.twist is the pullback of Proj.twist along f = toProjInt. Spec (ULift Z) is terminal, hence terminal.from it and the pullback projection f are isomorphisms. Scheme.Modules.pullbackIsoPushforwardInv, pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr and pushforwardId identify pullback f followed by pushforward f with the identity. Mathlib Adjunction.isIso_unit_of_iso makes the adjunction unit eta an isomorphism; take theta to be its inverse. This constructs the comparison without choosing any witness from an unproved existence statement.

twistOneSection is defined by applying eta to the polynomial global coordinate section. The hom-inverse identity gives theta(Tgl_k) = T_k. Naturality gives the chart restriction. On every point of D_+(T_i), val_unitToTwist_app_top and val_twistPowSection_apply identify both sides with the fraction T_i/1, proving theta(e_i) = twistPowSection 1.

For uniqueness precompose the two candidate morphisms with the isomorphism eta. They agree on each global polynomial coordinate section by their prescribed global images. The standard opens cover Proj by iSup_basicOpen_eq_top' and adjoin_range_X_eq_top. On D_+(T_i) the restriction of T_i equals twistPowSection 1 by the same pointwise fraction calculation; isFreeGenerator_twistPowSection proves this is a free generator, also on smaller opens. Thus on V intersect D_+(T_i) any section is a scalar multiple of this generator; linearity and naturality imply the maps agree. The sheaf condition eq_of_locally_eq' gives equality on V for every V. Cancel eta and apply Iso.ext. The proved private helper hom_ext_of_global_frames carries the linearity, restriction and sheaf-separation argument.
